newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse ends on muted note.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse ends on muted note.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Bel-20 index .BFX ends varied but active day on muted note as Dow .DJI slips after steep overnight gain.
* Bel-20 index up 0.57 points or 0.03 percent at 2,242.94 with eight gainers, two unchanged and 10 unchanged. More than three billion francs of Belgian shares traded.
* Oil major PetroFina busiest stock by value with more than 26,000 shares changing hands and price one percent higher at 12,925 francs.
* Main gainer steel cord and wire maker Bekaert, up 2.5 percent at 6,490 francs, followed by GBL, up 1.8 percent at 5,760 francs
